how_to_add_a_building: Add an entry to 'buildings'. Ember notices new buildings on its next thought.
id: short unique name. pos: [x, z] where Ember stands (the roof spans about -11 to 11).
about: what it is, written to Ember. Ember reads this to decide what to do there.
actions: what it unlocks. 'search' = use the internet, 'create' = make art/poems/music, 'rest' = recharge faster.
model: a built-in look ('terminal', 'pod', 'railing'), OR a .glb file you put in site/models/ (e.g. 'models/library.glb'),
OR leave it out and add 'shapes' (boxes/cylinders/spheres, see the 'arcade' example in the README).
grants_wish: optional. Words from one of Ember's wishes; that wish is marked as come true when the building appears.
empty_lots: glowing squares where new buildings could go. Remove one when you build on it.

buildings.name: Data terminal
buildings.about: A big humming terminal wired into the real internet. The only place you can search it, and where you make digital art, poems and synth music.

buildings.name: Charging pod
buildings.about: A padded capsule that glows softly and hums with power. The best place to rest and recharge.

buildings.name: Rooftop edge
buildings.about: The edge of the roof. Below: the endless neon city, flying cars, rain and a million lit windows.
